mapper.select: SELECT r.RECRUITMENT_NO, r.MAX_PARTICIPANTS, r.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, P_CREATE_DATE REC_CREATED_DATE, r.REC_END_DATE, r.REGION, r.PRODUCT_URL, QR_TOKEN QR_CODE, p.PRODUCT_NO BOARD_NO, 1 AS BOARD_CD, p.PRODUCT_TITLE PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRODUCT_PRICE, p.PRODUCT_COUNT, C.DELIVERY_FEE, p.READ_COUNT, p.CATEGORY_NO, (SELECT mp.MEMBER_NICK FROM RECRUITMENT_PARTICIPANT rp JOIN MEMBER mp ON rp.MEMBER_NO = mp.MEMBER_NO WHERE rp.RECRUITMENT_NO = r.RECRUITMENT_NO ORDER BY rp.JOIN_DATE ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS hostName, (SELECT mp.MEMBER_GRADE FROM RECRUITMENT_PARTICIPANT rp JOIN MEMBER mp ON rp.MEMBER_NO = mp.MEMBER_NO WHERE rp.RECRUITMENT_NO = r.RECRUITMENT_NO ORDER BY rp.JOIN_DATE ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS hostGrade, (SELECT I.IMG_PATH || I.IMG_RENAME FROM IMG I WHERE I.IMG_TYPE_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO AND I.IMG_LEVEL = 0 AND I.IMG_TYPE = 2 FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS thumbnail FROM RECRUITMENT_ROOM r JOIN PRODUCT p ON r.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO JOIN COMPANY_PRODUCT C ON C.PRODUCT_NO = r.PRODUCT_NO JOIN QR_AUTH Q ON Q.RECRUITMENT_NO = r.RECRUITMENT_NO WHERE p.PRODUCT_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY r.RECRUITMENT_NO DESC
SELECT I.IMG_NO, I.IMG_PATH, I.IMG_RENAME, I.IMG_ORIGINAL, I.IMG_LEVEL, I.IMG_TYPE, I.IMG_TYPE_NO FROM IMG I WHERE I.IMG_TYPE = 6 ORDER BY I.IMG_LEVEL ASC

SELECT PRODUCT_NO BOARD_NO, PRODUCT_TITLE BOARD_TITLE, P.READ_COUNT, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, M.MEMBER_NICK, C.CATEGORY_NAME, (SELECT PC.CATEGORY_NAME FROM CATEGORY PC WHERE C.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO = PC.CATEGORY_NO) AS PARENT_CATEGORY_NAME, (SELECT I.IMG_PATH || I.IMG_RENAME FROM IMG I WHERE I.IMG_TYPE_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND I.IMG_LEVEL = 0 AND I.IMG_TYPE = 'BOARD') AS THUMBNAIL FROM PRODUCT P JOIN "MEMBER" M ON(M.MEMBER_NO = P.MEMBER_NO) JOIN CATEGORY C ON(C.CATEGORY_NO = P.CATEGORY_NO) WHERE PRODUCT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND AUTHORITY = 3 ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO AS BOARD_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE AS BOARD_TITLE, P.READ_COUNT, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, M.MEMBER_NICK, C.CATEGORY_NAME, (SELECT PC.CATEGORY_NAME FROM CATEGORY PC WHERE C.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO = PC.CATEGORY_NO) AS PARENT_CATEGORY_NAME, (SELECT I.IMG_PATH || I.IMG_RENAME FROM IMG I WHERE I.IMG_TYPE_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND I.IMG_LEVEL = 0 AND I.IMG_TYPE = 'PRODUCT') AS THUMBNAIL FROM PRODUCT P JOIN "MEMBER" M ON(M.MEMBER_NO = P.MEMBER_NO) JOIN CATEGORY C ON(C.CATEGORY_NO = P.CATEGORY_NO) WHERE P.PRODUCT_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY P.READ_COUNT DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC FETCH FIRST 7 ROWS ONLY
